en.io: Inputs details about an AI system's architecture and operational context, and outputs vulnerability findings and structured security assessment steps.
en.boundary: This skill provides theoretical assessment methodology and checklists rather than executing automated exploit payloads or applying software patches.
scenarios: Auditing LLM applications for prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities
Evaluating training pipelines for data poisoning and model extraction risks
Red-teaming AI agent integrations and plugin permissions

zh.io: 输入 AI 系统的架构细节与运行上下文，输出漏洞评估发现与结构化的安全测试步骤。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅提供安全评估方法论和测试清单，不直接执行自动化漏洞利用攻击或修补系统缺陷。
scenarios: 审计 LLM 应用中的提示词注入与 Jailbreak 漏洞
评估训练数据管道中的数据投毒与模型抽取风险
对 AI Agent 的插件集成与权限治理进行红队评估
